entries.speaker: Man's Speech
entries.en: We must build a society in which the[n]young can be hopeful of a brighter[n]tomorrow, and—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's so damn loud...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrm? Where's Haru?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's the one that called us, so she'll[n]show up eventually.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, even though things have calmed[n]down, she must be occupied with[n]what happened to her father...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Wait, WHAT!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wh-What's up?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People are posting that we killed[n]President Okumura!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So it's begun already...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Think about it. The CEO collapsed the way[n]he did, during an apology conference that[n]our group caused.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They were raving about us so much...[n]and now they just treat us like murderers?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What a lightning-fast change of attitude!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They don't know a damn thing about[n]our situation!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Calm down. Not everyone is necessarily[n]saying that...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But there's no way to vindicate ourselves.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Haru!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry I'm late.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm the one who asked you all to[n]make time for me too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...My condolences. It must be rough.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm okay now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, I called everyone together because[n]there was something worrying me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Did you all target the principal?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? The principal? ...You mean ours?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What makes you say that?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yesterday, a public prosecutor came to[n]my home.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um... it was a woman named...[n]Niijima-san.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's—

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I overheard her saying a calling card was[n]found in the principal's office.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Considering that this was right after what[n]happened... It's got to be Shujin's.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's the first I've heard of it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Doesn't this all seem weird to you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It may just be my imagination...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I feel as if... things are escalating far[n]too quickly after President Okumura's[n]incident.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps... we may have been set up by[n]the real culprit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That could be...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then we need to catch them as soon[n]as possible.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hold a moment.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Can we assume we've been set up though?[n]We don't even know their objective.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What else are we supposed to do then!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's all calm down for a moment.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: From what Haru said, even the police are[n]suspecting that the Phantom Thieves are[n]murderers...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It wouldn't be wise to carelessly make a[n]move at the moment. We need to act as[n]normal students for now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In addition, we have midterms next week.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Exams? At a time like this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Rgh... I envy you, Futaba...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Got something on my mind. Gonna go[n]home and look into it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder what that could be.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At any rate, we need to behave and not[n]draw attention to ourselves. Understood?
